chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Day of 'Al-Hajj Al-Akbar', so he said, 'It is the Day of An-Nahr, and the smaller one is Al-'Umrah.'

key_terms.يَوْمُ اَلنَّحْرِ: The Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Qi'dah)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Al-Hajj Al-Akbar and Al-'Umrah according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides a precise jurisprudential definition by equating the 'Greater Pilgrimage' specifically with the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah), while identifying 'Umrah as the 'Minor Pilgrimage.' This distinction is crucial for understanding the temporal framework of Hajj rituals and the specific timing of expiations (kaffarat) for pilgrims who commit errors or exceed boundaries during the sacred months. The hadith reflects the Imami scholarly emphasis on clarifying ambiguous terms in early Islamic practice to ensure correct ritual performance.
